raw_text: Ah now i get why i thought grok and claude was not being used. A new solo project is being created for each worktree. That should not happen, the main orbit solo project should be used always. The agents should then be pointed to the correct worktree when spawned in the main solo orbit project

expectation: Use the main Orbit Solo project and bind agents to the exact worktree

protection.rejected_example: Register the feature worktree as a new Solo project
protection.accepted_example: Spawn the agent in the main Orbit Solo project and pass the exact worktree target
